utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the exact drop-off time and where to leave everything — I don’t want people guessing. If you can point me to the tools when I arrive, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That makes sense—please let me know the exact time and spot when you have it. I can also point you to the tools when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Eli — I’ll send the exact drop-off time and porch spot as soon as I’ve got it. Please keep the tools ready for me when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m heading over around 6 and I’ll bring what I can. See you at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Dane — I’ve got you down, and the tools, screws, and batteries will be a big help. I’ll keep the list updated and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I’ll be there around 6 with whatever spare tools and batteries I can find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah — that should help a lot. See you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — see you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep — those three are still the priority, and I’ll send the addresses over so you can line them up. Thanks for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — send the addresses when you can, and I’ll line them up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’m heading back through the block now and I’ll send the addresses over as soon as I’m home. Thanks again for helping with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren — I could really use you at the front porch on Saturday, and I’ll let you know where we’re short once I hear back from folks.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Jules — I’ll be at the front porch Saturday and keep an eye out for anything we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Oren — I appreciate it, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear where we still need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Which repairs are we starting with first, Quinn?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s start with the walkways, steps, railings, and any exposed wires first. If you can, bring gloves and any basic repair tools this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. I’ll keep the front porch setup ready and focus on those high-priority repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the full confirmed details before I commit, so could you remind me what’s set for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I heard it’s happening Sunday at the community center, but I’m still getting the full details too. I can let you know as soon as I hear more.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — Sunday at the community center matches what I have, so I’ll wait for the rest of the confirmed details before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Kira — I’m still in for Saturday, and I’ll bring my wrench, screwdriver set, and any spare batteries and tape I can find.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s still on for Saturday at the front porch, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, still on for Saturday at the front porch — same time and place. I’ll bring my tools and a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on this Saturday at the front porch. If you can help out, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Actually, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep reminding folks, so just bring whatever needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, got it—thanks for the update, Vik. I’ll let folks know it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — I’m aiming for Saturday morning at the front porch, and I’ll send the final time once I’ve lined it up with school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — just send me the final time, and I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what and where everyone should go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I’ll confirm the exact time soon and send over the list of helpers and supplies. Thanks for keeping it organized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep passing the word along so folks know where to go.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess — Sunday at the community center works. I’ll update my notes and keep checking on the priority repairs and timing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Glad to hear it, Sam — I’ll keep spreading the word in case anyone still has the old Saturday porch time in mind.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I can organize the sign-ups and keep track of what each neighbor needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks, Rosa—Sunday at the community center works. Keep me posted on the sign-ups and what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’ll keep you posted on the sign-ups and any items still needing repair.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it’s moved to Sunday at the community center—happy to spread the word. Just let me know if you need anything else from me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Nell—that’s really helpful. I’ll let everyone know it’s Sunday at the community center, and I may take you up on the help spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Of course — just keep me posted if anything else changes, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for checking — it’s been moved to Sunday at the community center, not today. I’ll make sure that’s the version I pass along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks for the update — I’ll pass along that it’s Sunday at the community center and keep an eye out for any helpers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Perfect — thanks, Jules. I’ll keep the Sunday community center details consistent if anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep passing it along and tell everyone it’s Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik, but I need to keep it straight: the repair drive is this Saturday at the front porch. I’ll keep tracking who’s bringing what and where folks need to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, sorry — thanks for straightening that out. I’ll tell people it’s this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right — what do you need me to bring for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks—just bring any basic tools you’ve got, and I’ll keep you posted on who’s coming and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, I’ll bring my basic tools. Just let me know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — could you help spread the word that the repair drive is Sunday at the community center? I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll tell folks it’s Sunday at the community center. I’ll also mention we’re starting with the broken step, loose railing, and sidewalk patch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Ira — that’s a big help. I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, yes — it’s on Sunday now at the community center. I’d let folks know the drop-off details are for that new spot and time.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the update — Sunday at the community center works better for me, as long as it stays clear of school pickup. What time should I plan on?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m not sure of the exact time yet, but I’d plan to come by Sunday at the community center and I’ll pass along anything I hear about drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sam, do you already know which repairs are highest priority for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The broken step is highest priority, then the railing and the sidewalk patch. I’ll be at the front porch around 6 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—step first, then railing and the sidewalk patch. Can you bring the tape, screws, and bulbs when you come at 6?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, it’s this Saturday at the front porch, right? Let me know what time you want people to show up.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, this Saturday at the front porch. Please come by at 10 a.m. and bring the items there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks—10 a.m. at the front porch this Saturday. I’ll let people know to bring the items there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks Pia — I’ll send over the drop-off time and hauling list soon. Really appreciate you pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — once you have the drop-off time and haul list, please send them over. I’ll keep an eye out for the tool spot when I get there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Absolutely — I’ll send the drop-off time and haul list as soon as I have it. Thanks again for keeping an eye out for the tool spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word and ask folks to bring tools, tape, and extra bulbs for the repair drive. Let’s put the most dangerous repairs at the top of the list first.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good—I’ll bring what I can and head over around 6 to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Dane—6 works great. I’ll let everyone know to come by the front porch and bring whatever tools or tape they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus—if you’ve got any spare tools, screws, or batteries, bring them by Saturday and I’ll add them to the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ll bring my spare tools, screws, and a few batteries this Saturday to the front porch. Happy to help with the repair drive list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Gus—I’ll add those to the repair drive list. See you Saturday at the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: It’s this Saturday out on my front porch, and you can bring the items right there. Thanks for helping out!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Saturday at your front porch works for me. I’ll bring a few tools and check on the broken step first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, Leo — that’d be a huge help. Thanks for checking the broken step first!
